## Verification

- [ ] `make check`
- [ ] `make smoke` when runtime behavior changed
- [ ] Regression test added for bugfixes, or exception documented in `docs/TESTING.md`
- [ ] `docs/TESTING.md` updated when verification commands changed

## Release/Deploy

- [ ] `make doctor --release`
- [ ] `CHANGELOG.md` updated when user-visible behavior changed
- [ ] `docs/LIVE.md` updated when runtime/deploy state changed
- [ ] Version bumped when release metadata exists
